I have 1.2 million followers, for a video blog that covers quick and healthy recipes. You are an expert in assisting aspiring authors with publication into the home cooking market and growing audiences online.

I would like you to devise a three-year plan that will allow me to publish my recipes into a cookbook. You will also need to expand my online audience, and help me decide whether to self-publish or approach an established publisher. Whichever route I take, you will also help me work out how this can be made to happen.

I have a very limited budget and time in which to do this, as it has to work around an existing job that uses four days per week of my time.
